newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks surged 2.01 percent on Tuesday amid specualtive buying but dealers said some leading blue chips came off on profit-taking.
They said demand from speculative retail investors in second-tier stocks pushed the index up though the market opened slightly lower.
"The retail investor is out for any stock that seems to have the potential to rise," dealer Ali Asghar said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 34.70 points to end at 1,762.61 from 1,718.96 in early trade. Gainers led losers 277 to 52.
